title: What Each Feed and Animal Nutrition Programme Carries in Ration Changes, Farm Visits and Analyses
content:
Every programme in the Feed and Animal Nutrition Programmes carries a stated number of ration changes, nutritionist farm visits and laboratory feed analyses in a year, charges a stated rate for anything beyond that number, and takes a stated notice in calendar days before a new formula is run.

## Carried in the year

| Programme | Ration changes carried | Nutritionist farm visits carried | Laboratory feed analyses carried |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Bagged Feed Cash Account | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Bulk Delivered Feed Account | 2 | 1 | 1 |
| Custom Mix Ration Program | 6 | 2 | 2 |
| Contracted Ingredient Program | 6 | 3 | 4 |
| Full Nutrition Partner Program | 12 | 6 | 8 |
| Medicated Feed VFD Program | 4 | 2 | 4 |

## Charged beyond what is carried, and notice before a new formula is run

| Programme | Ration change beyond the number carried | Farm visit beyond the number carried | Analysis beyond the number carried | Calendar days of notice a ration change takes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Bagged Feed Cash Account | $0.00 | $175.00 | $85.00 | 0 |
| Bulk Delivered Feed Account | $60.00 | $175.00 | $85.00 | 3 |
| Custom Mix Ration Program | $45.00 | $150.00 | $75.00 | 3 |
| Contracted Ingredient Program | $45.00 | $150.00 | $60.00 | 5 |
| Full Nutrition Partner Program | $0.00 | $125.00 | $50.00 | 3 |
| Medicated Feed VFD Program | $75.00 | $150.00 | $60.00 | 7 |

## The schedule in words

A Bagged Feed Cash Account carries none of the three; a Full Nutrition Partner Program carries twelve ration changes, six farm visits and eight analyses, and charges the lowest rates of any programme for a visit at a hundred and twenty-five dollars and for an analysis at fifty. The Medicated Feed VFD Program charges the highest ration change rate of the six at seventy-five dollars and takes the longest notice at seven calendar days.

*Hypothetical.* On a Contracted Ingredient Program, the fourth analysis in the year falls within the four the programme carries; a fifth in the same year is charged at sixty dollars.

*Hypothetical.* On a Bulk Delivered Feed Account, the second ration change in the year is the last of the two carried; a third is charged at sixty dollars.
